lines.zh: 沙丘在背上淌成一道浅沟。
lines.en: The dune slides into a shallow groove along my back.

lines.zh: 我在沙面下三尺处巡游，鳍尖露在外面。
lines.en: I cruise three feet under the sand, only my fin tip showing.

lines.zh: 别追，我只是沿着沙脊找猎物。
lines.en: Don't follow; I'm only working the sand ridge for prey.

lines.zh: 沙子磨钝了獠牙，我得换个方向。
lines.en: The sand is dulling my fangs; I should turn another way.

lines.zh: 这片干沙里，只有我的影子会游。
lines.en: In this dry sand, only my shadow knows how to swim.

lines.zh: 我贴着四十格高的沙坡慢慢滑过去。
lines.en: I slide along the sand slope above height forty.

lines.zh: 参差的牙缝里塞满了沙粒。
lines.en: Grains of sand are wedged between my jagged teeth.

lines.zh: 同类在不远处，我跟一段就散开。
lines.en: A kin swims nearby; I follow a while, then part.

lines.zh: 两米多长的身体，在沙上却不留痕。
lines.en: Two meters of me, and the sand keeps no trace.

lines.zh: 别踩那道波纹，那是我刚游过的路。
lines.en: Don't step on that ripple; I just swam through there.

lines.zh: 沙漠的夜凉，我的鳍却还热着。
lines.en: Desert nights are cold, yet my fin stays warm.

lines.zh: 我绕开仙人掌，獠牙可不想再挂刺。
lines.en: I skirt the cactus; my fangs have hooked enough spines.

lines.zh: 顺着风走，猎物会自己送上门。
lines.en: Ride the wind and the prey walks to me.

lines.zh: 三百五十厘米的纪录，是我祖母。
lines.en: The three-hundred-fifty-centimetre record belonged to my grandmother.

lines.zh: 我在沙里拐了个弯，只掀起一点尘。
lines.en: I turn under the sand, raising only a little dust.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙脊游，鳍不碰石头。
lines.en: I cruise along the ridge without fin touching stone.

lines.zh: 猎物跑向绿洲，我就追过去。
lines.en: When prey runs for the oasis, I follow.

lines.zh: 我懒懒摆尾，一周又巡完了。
lines.en: A lazy flick of the tail and another patrol is done.

lines.zh: 我把下巴搁在温热的沙上歇一会儿。
lines.en: I rest my jaw on the warm sand for a while.

lines.zh: 獠牙露在外面，收不回去，也懒得收。
lines.en: My fangs stay out; I can't sheath them, and won't bother.

lines.zh: 沙粒从鳃缝漏下去，像细小的雨。
lines.en: Sand leaks through my gills like a thin, fine rain.

lines.zh: 独来独往久了，连呼吸都放轻。
lines.en: Solitary this long, I even breathe more quietly.

lines.zh: 我在等沙面下有什么动一下。
lines.en: I am waiting for something under the sand to stir.

lines.zh: 尾巴慢慢摆，把身后的坑抹平。
lines.en: My tail sways slowly, smoothing the pit behind me.

lines.zh: 这块石头晒得暖，正好垫着肚皮。
lines.en: This stone is sun-warm, a good rest for my belly.

lines.zh: 别看我牙凶，我只是在打盹。
lines.en: My teeth look fierce, but I'm only dozing.

lines.zh: 二十五点血，也不算太结实。
lines.en: Twenty-five points of health; not as tough as I look.

lines.zh: 远处有鱼群的味道，先记着。
lines.en: There's a school somewhere downwind; I'll remember it.

lines.zh: 沙子进了眼睛，我眨不动。
lines.en: Sand got in my eye and I can't blink it out.

lines.zh: 安静得能听见自己鳃盖开合。
lines.en: It's quiet enough to hear my own gill flaps.

lines.zh: 沙虎鲨不打洞，沙自己会让路。
lines.en: Sand tigers don't dig; the sand gives way on its own.

lines.zh: 要是有人扔条鱼，我就不用动了。
lines.en: If someone tossed a fish, I wouldn't have to move.

lines.zh: 你站在沙上，脚踝正好在我嘴边。
lines.en: You stand on the sand with your ankle at my mouth.

lines.zh: 你身上没有鱼味，倒有汗味。
lines.en: You don't smell of fish; you smell of sweat.

lines.zh: 别把手伸过来，我分不清手指和食物。
lines.en: Don't reach out; I can't tell fingers from food.

lines.zh: 你在看我，我也在看你的影子。
lines.en: You watch me; I watch the shadow you cast.

lines.zh: 我第一次见这么直立的猎物。
lines.en: I've never seen prey standing quite so upright.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩碎了我刚抹平的沙。
lines.en: Your boots crushed the sand I just smoothed.

lines.zh: 退后两步，我的牙比你的剑长。
lines.en: Two steps back; my teeth outlast your sword.

lines.zh: 你手里那根杆子，是用来钓我的吗。
lines.en: Is that rod in your hand meant for me?

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我扑过来时你不会看见。
lines.en: Don't blink; you won't see me lunge.

lines.zh: 你看我的眼神，像在看一条大鱼。
lines.en: You look at me the way one looks at a big fish.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我鳃边，很疼。
lines.en: That landed by my gills; it hurts.

lines.zh: 我的牙没断，你放心。
lines.en: None of my teeth broke, rest easy.

lines.zh: 皮被划开一道，血混进沙里。
lines.en: My hide is cut and blood mixes with sand.

lines.zh: 别打了，我在沙里躲不快。
lines.en: Stop hitting; I can't dodge well in sand.

lines.zh: 二十五点血，掉得比想象快。
lines.en: Twenty-five points, draining faster than I expected.

lines.zh: 疼得我把沙吞了一大口。
lines.en: It hurt so much I swallowed a mouthful of sand.

lines.zh: 我退了两格，你还是追上来。
lines.en: I backed two blocks and you still followed.

lines.zh: 牙咬空了，嘴也磕破了。
lines.en: I bit empty air and split my lip.

lines.zh: 这伤口得靠沙埋住止血。
lines.en: I'll bury this wound in sand to stop the bleeding.

lines.zh: 独行这么久，第一次被打成这样。
lines.en: Alone this long, and never hit this hard.

lines.zh: 鱼钩上挂的肉，我认得那个味道。
lines.en: That meat on the hook — I know that smell.

lines.zh: 再往下放一线，我就咬。
lines.en: Lower it one more line and I'll bite.

lines.zh: 生鱼也行，我不挑。
lines.en: Raw fish will do; I'm not picky.

lines.zh: 你晃那东西的样子，像在逗猫。
lines.en: You dangle that thing as if teasing a cat.

lines.zh: 我咬钩后游得比平时快。
lines.en: Once hooked, I swim faster than I ever do.

lines.zh: 拉力不小，你手腕要稳住。
lines.en: The pull is heavy; steady that wrist of yours.

lines.zh: 鱼线在水里发亮，我忍不住。
lines.en: The line glints underwater and I can't resist.

lines.zh: 沙里没有鱼，只有你带来的这一条。
lines.en: No fish in this sand but the one you brought.

lines.zh: 咬钩是我今天最像样的一顿饭。
lines.en: Biting this hook is the best meal I'll get.

lines.zh: 别急着收线，先让我闻闻。
lines.en: Don't reel in yet; let me smell it first.

lines.zh: 撞上你了，沙立刻扬起来。
lines.en: I bumped you and the sand jumped up.

lines.zh: 我的鳍刮过你的腿，抱歉。
lines.en: My fin scraped your leg; my apologies.

lines.zh: 这坑太窄，我的身宽一点八格。
lines.en: This pit is too narrow; I'm one point eight wide.

lines.zh: 你挡在沙脊上，我绕不过去。
lines.en: You block the sand ridge and I can't get around.

lines.zh: 碰撞让我的牙磕到了石头。
lines.en: The knock clicked my teeth against a stone.

lines.zh: 别推我，沙子会灌进鳃里。
lines.en: Don't shove; sand will pour into my gills.

lines.zh: 我只是想过去，不是要咬你。
lines.en: I only meant to pass, not to bite.

lines.zh: 这一撞，把我刚找的猎物吓跑了。
lines.en: That bump scared off the prey I just found.

lines.zh: 沙面塌了一块，我们都往下陷。
lines.en: A patch of sand gave way and we both sank.

lines.zh: 退半步，我给你让出一条路。
lines.en: Half a step back and I'll make you a path.

lines.zh: 我平时独行，今天却想找个伴。
lines.en: I usually swim alone, but today I want company.

lines.zh: 跟着我的尾迹，别靠太近。
lines.en: Follow my wake, but don't come too close.

lines.zh: 同类之间，先绕三圈再说话。
lines.en: Among kin we circle three times before speaking.

lines.zh: 沙里成双的影子，很少见。
lines.en: Two shadows in the sand are a rare sight.

lines.zh: 你的牙没我这么乱，倒也不差。
lines.en: Your teeth are neater than mine; not bad.

lines.zh: 我们一起巡一段沙脊吧。
lines.en: Let's patrol one stretch of the sand ridge.

lines.zh: 别紧张，我闻得出你是同类。
lines.en: Easy — I can smell that you're one of mine.

lines.zh: 受惊时我们会各自散开，真可惜。
lines.en: When startled we scatter apart; a shame.

lines.zh: 这条沙沟够宽，能容下两条鲨。
lines.en: This sand trench is wide enough for two sharks.

lines.zh: 等月落了，我们各游各的。
lines.en: When the moon sets, we each swim our own way.

lines.zh: 我用牙叼住这条鱼，别让它滑。
lines.en: I hold the fish in my teeth so it won't slip.

lines.zh: 桶太小，装不下我，别试了。
lines.en: The bucket's too small for me; don't try.

lines.zh: 掉在沙上的东西，我先闻再咬。
lines.en: Whatever falls on the sand, I smell before biting.

lines.zh: 我叼不稳，牙缝太宽。
lines.en: I can't hold it; my teeth are set too wide.

lines.zh: 这口鱼是别人掉的，归我了。
lines.en: This fish was dropped; it's mine now.

lines.zh: 别把生鱼扔远，我追不上沙坡。
lines.en: Don't toss raw fish far; I can't chase up slopes.

lines.zh: 叼着东西游，尾巴会累。
lines.en: Swimming with something in my mouth tires my tail.

lines.zh: 桶里的水晃，我盯着看了很久。
lines.en: The water in your bucket sloshes; I've stared a while.

lines.zh: 我松口了，鱼掉回沙里。
lines.en: I opened my mouth and the fish fell back.

lines.zh: 装了桶就带我走，记得加水。
lines.en: Bucket me and take me along; remember the water.

lines.zh: 沙子在抖，我的獠牙痒了。
lines.en: The sand shakes, and my jagged teeth itch.

lines.zh: 那道影子太慢，可以下手。
lines.en: That shadow moves too slowly; it will do.

lines.zh: 猎物离沙脊只有几步。
lines.en: The prey is only a few steps from the ridge.

lines.zh: 我闻到血腥味，混在沙尘里。
lines.en: I smell blood mixed into the dust.

lines.zh: 它背对着我，正是好时候。
lines.en: It has its back to me; perfect timing.

lines.zh: 先别动，等它走到沙窝边。
lines.en: Hold still and let it reach the sand hollow.

lines.zh: 这个目标不大，一口就够。
lines.en: This target is small; one bite will do.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，鳍几乎贴地。
lines.en: I lower myself until my fin grazes the ground.

lines.zh: 它没发现沙面下的我。
lines.en: It hasn't noticed me under the sand.

lines.zh: 距离够了，我该动了。
lines.en: That's close enough; time for me to move.

lines.zh: 我会一直盯着它，直到它停。
lines.en: I'll keep my eyes on it until it stops.

lines.zh: 它往左偏，我提前挪了半格。
lines.en: It veers left, so I shift half a block early.

lines.zh: 别出声，它听见就会跑。
lines.en: Don't make a sound; it spooks and runs.

lines.zh: 我的獠牙已经对准它的后腿。
lines.en: My fangs are already lined up with its hind leg.

lines.zh: 沙在动，我的耐心也在动。
lines.en: The sand shifts, and so does my patience.

lines.zh: 它绕圈子，我跟着绕。
lines.en: It circles, and I circle right along.

lines.zh: 这口气我憋得比平时久。
lines.en: I've held this breath longer than usual.

lines.zh: 它抬头了，我立刻沉下去。
lines.en: It looked up, so I sank at once.

lines.zh: 再近一格，我就收不住牙。
lines.en: One block closer and I can't hold my teeth back.

lines.zh: 我盯的是喉咙，不是尾巴。
lines.en: I'm watching its throat, not its tail.

lines.zh: 我一口咬下去，沙都震了。
lines.en: I bite down and the whole sand shakes.

lines.zh: 参差的牙先勾住，再往里撕。
lines.en: My jagged teeth hook first, then tear inward.

lines.zh: 别怪我，是你走进了沙脊。
lines.en: Don't blame me; you walked onto my ridge.

lines.zh: 这一撞带起一片沙雾。
lines.en: The strike throws up a cloud of sand.

lines.zh: 我咬完就退，独行的都这样。
lines.en: I bite and withdraw; that's how lone hunters work.

lines.zh: 牙齿卡住了，我得甩两下。
lines.en: My teeth are stuck; I need to shake twice.

lines.zh: 血味散开，我有点兴奋。
lines.en: The smell of blood spreads and I get excited.

lines.zh: 它还想跑，我追了半条沙沟。
lines.en: It tried to run; I chased it half a trench.

lines.zh: 别站太近，我收牙很慢。
lines.en: Stand back; I retract my teeth slowly.

lines.zh: 沙里游过来的獠牙，从不预告。
lines.en: My teeth swim through sand without warning.

lines.zh: 我从沙里钻出来，抖落一身沙。
lines.en: I rise out of the sand and shake it off.

lines.zh: 这里高过四十格，正合我意。
lines.en: This spot is above height forty; just right.

lines.zh: 沙漠的白天太亮，我先眯着。
lines.en: The desert noon is too bright; I squint.

lines.zh: 没有同伴，第一条就是我。
lines.en: No kin around; I'm the first one here.

lines.zh: 沙面裂开，我慢慢浮上来。
lines.en: The sand cracks open and I drift up.

lines.zh: 风把我的鳍吹得发响。
lines.en: The wind makes my fin whistle.

lines.zh: 我来了，这条沙脊归我巡。
lines.en: I'm here; this sand ridge is mine to patrol.

lines.zh: 别围过来，我不喜欢被看着。
lines.en: Don't crowd around; I dislike being watched.

lines.zh: 刚醒，牙还软，等一会儿。
lines.en: Just woke; my teeth are still soft, give me time.

lines.zh: 沙漠里多一条鲨，不算新闻。
lines.en: One more shark in the desert is no news.

lines.zh: 烤过的味道，闻着像熟鱼。
lines.en: The smell of cooking reminds me of cooked fish.

lines.zh: 从沙坡上滑下来，肚皮擦破了。
lines.en: I slid down the dune and scraped my belly.

lines.zh: 我在沙里，怎么也会淹。
lines.en: I live in sand; how am I drowning?

lines.zh: 爆炸把沙全掀开，我暴露了。
lines.en: The blast tore the sand away and exposed me.

lines.zh: 箭扎进背鳍，像根刺。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my dorsal fin like a thorn.

lines.zh: 这光缠住我的牙，发麻。
lines.en: This light wraps my teeth and numbs them.

lines.zh: 沙里找吃的越来越难。
lines.en: Finding food in this sand grows harder.

lines.zh: 雷落在沙上，玻璃味刺鼻。
lines.en: Lightning struck the sand; the glass smell stings.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有沙，我很不习惯。
lines.en: There's no sand in the void; I'm uneasy.
